# Malformed MSI Regression

`msi-null-column-type.msi` is the unchanged input from the local instrumented
package fuzz run dated 2026-10-05, iteration 935. It mutates the repository's
synthetic MSI fixture, not third-party production media. Upstream msi 0.10.0
panicked while unwrapping a required `_Columns` Type value. The local fork
must reject it with an error without unwinding or aborting.

SHA-256: `f2e7fdd74ef460e2f5a18f7746d8c345183efdcfc186db433305e90c064b5bf6`.

## Authoring fixtures, 2026-10-08

New fixtures under `authoring/` are synthetic unsigned stored output from the
optional writer. They do not replace the malformed MSI regression above.
Microsoft MakeAppx 10.0.26100.1742 unpacked the package and unbundled both nested
architecture packages. The single package was also repacked with validation.
See [qualification evidence](../../docs/package-authoring-validation.md).

- `stored.msix`: generated by `tests/browser-authoring/examples/native.rs`,
  payload `worker authoring payload`; SHA-256
  `760d91ba8c79fb3b6e63c61a2f23095781ea80b53e563b1cbe77549ef2c4f952`.
- `stored.msixbundle`: generated by `examples/author_bundle.rs`, two architectures,
  format-only dummy executable and generated PNGs; SHA-256
  `3bfb0f1467339c250ed2ea7f59c07029836916258e27aff9599900c5c5aee6b8`.

The XML writer was `woxml` 0.6.0 and authoring parser `roxmltree` 0.21.1, with
default features disabled. These fixtures establish explicit format experiments,
not signed deployment, trust or executable functionality.
